channel.title: LaGrange Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from LaGrange Daily News (lagrangenews.com)

item.title: Sheriff’s Office investigator leads Human Trafficking Awareness Seminar for healthcare workers
item.description: Wellstar West Georgia Medical Center staff trained to spot human trafficking victims in healthcare settings during a seminar led by Troup County Sheriff’s Office Investigator Jessica Noles.

item.title: Point University honors retiring staff member
item.description: Point University will launch the Wye Huxford Center for Spiritual Formation to honor his 50 years of service as he retires and delivers this year’s commencement address.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - John Tures: Don’t Expect Tariffs To Reduce The Trade Deficit, Or To Get A Tariff Rebate
item.description: A Supreme Court ruling against Trump’s tariffs shows Americans are footing the bill—without shrinking the trade deficit or securing the tariff rebates many expected.

item.title: TOTY Behrmann encourages students to enjoy the learning process
item.description: Callaway Middle’s Teacher of the Year Keren Behrmann builds joyful, creative ELA classrooms where strong relationships and student passion projects help teens find their voice.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - L. Michelle Moore: Behind the Meter Nuclear?
item.description: As the U.S. military and tech giants pursue private “behind-the-meter” nuclear reactors, a contributor examines their promise, safety challenges and community risks.

item.title: West Point celebrates Black History Month
item.description: West Point’s 23rd annual Black History Program draws a packed crowd to celebrate unity, student achievements and a message of giving from $1 Thursday founder Anthony Talley.

item.title: First Peoples Bank expands into LaGrange
item.description: First Peoples Bank opens LaGrange branch at 206 W. Haralson St., returning CEO Charles Sweat to the former LaGrange Banking Company site he launched in 2008.

item.title: LaGrange boys and girls soccer teams beat Mary Persons for region win
item.description: LaGrange boys and girls soccer stay perfect in region play, as the girls roll 5-0 behind Luci Collins’ hat trick and the boys secure a 3-1 win over Mary Persons.

item.title: LaGrange College women's basketball team wins first conference tournament
item.description: LaGrange College women's basketball team wins first conference tournament

item.title: PHOTOS: LaGrange High baseball in action at the LaGrange Toyota Invitational on Friday and Saturday
item.description: See photos from LaGrange High’s matchups with Northridge, Houston County and Central Phenix City at the LaGrange Toyota Invitational.
